column5: the console's state-changing forms are Next.js server actions, which carry no token by design: Next.js refuses an action whose Origin is not the console's, and apps/dashboard/src/security/origin-checks.test.ts holds the origin check on every state-changing handler and action; these pages' GET forms (filters) change nothing

column4: the console renders it as text
column5: ZAP's Low, low-confidence weakness: a script tag the scan stored earlier (an operator's own MFA factor name, a request the API log recorded) comes back verbatim in a JSON answer (application/json, never HTML); the console renders these values as React text and apps/dashboard/src holds no dangerouslySetInnerHTML; KP11-70 adds nosniff to the JSON answers

every API answer, JSON, problem+json and /health and /ready among them, carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff from buildApp's onRequest hook (apps/api/src/http/nosniff.test.ts); the alerts before the fix were Low

ZAP's CSP notice fires because report-uri is present at all; the console has named report-to beside it since 61ca9afa5 (Phase 9), proxy.ts sends Reporting-Endpoints on every answer, and report-uri stays for Firefox; apps/dashboard/src/security/console-csp.test.ts holds both on every console route; Low
GET / with a session answers 307 to /inquiries with a 5,258-byte body: Next.js's redirect shell (the title and its scripts, checked on this stack: no inquiry id, address or other record in it); Low
the API-log filter's user-id in the console's URL is a usr_ handle (review P33), not a secret
the console's list filters echo their own query values into form attributes, which React escapes; ZAP's informational heuristic
ZAP's note that the page is a modern web application (its spider cannot run the scripts)
ZAP's informational note of a 4xx answer: the API's validation answers ZAP's generated and attack requests with 400, 404, 409, 415 or 422 (RFC 9457 problem+json); no 5xx answer was recorded
ZAP's User Agent Fuzzer saw some answers differ when only the User-Agent header changed (a validation or rate-limit answer between its variants); informational
